text:
Anna (PM): Quick standup item  need a one-page cutover acceptance checklist for Private deploys where customers own networking. Short bullets only.

Raj (Eng): +1. Must include: preflight exit codes, rolling agent upgrade behavior, explicit rollback knob, and artifact signing.

Marta (Field): Add a "customer responsibilities" column: network owner contact, ASN/IP confirmation, firewall windows, DNS cutover slot.

Kyle (NetOps): NetOps gating: BGP dry-run that validates egress IP continuity and AS path. Require installer to emit egress->node mapping file.

Jia (SRE): Observability: minimal metrics (upgrade_progress, agent_version, egress_ip_diff), an event timeline, and telemetry opt-out that honors KMS. Short runbook for top 3 failures.

Raj (Eng): Draft compact gates:
- Preflight: ports, kernel, disk, NAT/iptable scan
- Dry-run: simulate BGP handoff, verify egress IP map
- Upgrade: canary 10% -> roll, non-destructive agent rollback
- Rollback: documented steps to restore agent + ip state within 30m for supported configs
- Packaging: online installer + signed airgap bundle (sha256)
- Observability: metrics + event log + KMS-aware telemetry
- Support: contracted cutover assistance, P1 triage SLA
- Exclusions: customer BGP misconfig, in-rack HW faults, custom kernel hacks

Marta (Field): Include example customer signoff line: "Network owner confirms ASN and egress IP plan and approves dry-run". Also an FAQ line about DNS TTLs and expected propagation lag.

Kyle (NetOps): Ill provide the dry-run script and verification commands (bgpctl, traceroute, curl of egress IP). ETA Tue EOD.

Jia (SRE): Ill drop the metrics snippet and a 1-page troubleshooting playbook. ETA Wed AM.

Raj (Eng): Ill own preflight tooling + rollback docs. ETA Tue EOD.

Anna (PM): GA gating proposal: require two successful customer-verified cutovers on different topologies (on-prem BGP + cloud VPC) with rollback exercised. Any objections?

Marta (Field): Strong yes. Past launches need >=2 topologies to catch edge cases.

Raj (Eng): OK. Define "successful": canary->full upgrade, rollback tested, metrics within normal bounds, no IP drift for 48h post-cutover.

Kyle (NetOps): Also require one validation include airgap or constrained-control-plane conditions.

Anna (PM): Great. Ill synth the one-pager and internal checklist and ping for signoff. Thanks. :pray:

deploy-bot: New doc uploaded: /docs/private-deploy/cutover-acceptance-checklist-v1.md (internal)

Marta (Field): Noted, will review when Anna posts the draft. :eyes:
